errors.text_span: По хоризонталната ос са разположени четирите метода, като всеки от тях е представен с два стълба — един за точност (ляво, с лявата Y-ос) и един за брой токени (дясно, с дясната Y-ос).
errors.evidence: The chart's structure is incorrectly described. It does not show four groups of two bars each. The methods are distinguished by color within each group, not grouped side-by-side on the x-axis.

errors.text_span: Стълбовете за точност са подредени по намаляващ ред, докато тези за брой токени — по нарастващ ред
errors.evidence: Neither set of bars is sorted as described. The accuracy values (91.19, 80.89, 88.50, 88.40) are not in descending order. The token count values (676.85, 534.24, 445.91, 354.46) are in descending order, not ascending.

errors.text_span: като CoUT има най-нисък брой токени и същевременно висока точност, близка до CoT.
errors.evidence: This statement makes subjective comparisons and interpretations ('висока точност', 'близка до CoT') that are not explicitly stated in the chart. Describing accuracy as 'high' is subjective, and while the values can be compared, stating that CoUT's accuracy (88.40) is 'close to' CoT's (91.19) is an inference.

errors.text_span: with each method represented by two adjacent bars—one for accuracy (left-side scale) and one for token count (right-side scale)
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the chart shows two adjacent bars per method. The chart is actually organized into two separate groups of bars: the four bars on the left show the 'Accuracy' for the four methods, and the four bars on the right show the 'Token Count' for the same four methods.

errors.text_span: The chart visually emphasizes CoUT’s efficiency, delivering near-parity in accuracy with CCoT while using significantly fewer tokens, and highlights CoT’s high performance at the cost of computational expense.
errors.evidence: This sentence provides an analysis and interpretation of the data, using subjective and evaluative language such as 'efficiency', 'near-parity', 'significantly fewer', and 'high performance at the cost of computational expense'. It describes conclusions drawn from the data rather than objectively describing the visual information presented in the chart.

errors.text_span: während die x-Achse die vier Methoden als Kategorien anzeigt. Jede Methode wird durch einen einzelnen Balken dargestellt
errors.evidence: The chart is not organized with methods on the x-axis. It is divided into two sections, "Accuracy (%)" and "Token Count". Each method (CoT, CoD, CCoT, CoUT) is represented by two separate bars, one in each section, not by a single bar.

errors.text_span: Der rote CoT-Balken erreicht eine Genauigkeit von 91,19 % und eine Tokenanzahl von 676,85, der orange CoD-Balken 80,89 % Genauigkeit und 534,24 Token, der hellblaue CCoT-Balken 88,50 % Genauigkeit und 445,91 Token sowie der grüne CoUT-Balken 88,40 % Genauigkeit und 354,46 Token.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly combines the two separate bars for each method into one, assigning both an accuracy value and a token count value to a single conceptual bar. In the chart, for each method, one bar represents its accuracy and a different bar in a separate section represents its token count.
